name: Peacockle · Gremlet #26
description:
A peacock spider. It unfurls a rainbow fan and dances for anyone who'll watch.

One of 50 one-of-a-kind Gremlets. Owning this token unlocks Peacockle in the Gremlets desktop app, where it walks on your windows, naps, plays with other Gremlets and shows off its signature move.
